svg.text: MCU interfaces, reset/debug access, power decoupling and clock support
35 × 35 mm | 4-layer PCB | Hardware prototype — assembly/firmware/bench qualification pending
Place bypass capacitors close to VDD
TMP102 uses software I²C: PB7 SDA / PB6 SCL.
Buzzer: PA6 TIM3_CH1. RGB: PA5 / PA7 / PB0.
Unused GPIO and USB-C CC pins are explicitly NC.
